name: Listing Reviews for Directorist with Yelp
author: WP Dreamers

sections.description:
Listing Reviews for Directorist with Yelp is a Directorist add-on that pulls live data from the Yelp Fusion API and renders a “Nearby Reviews” section on every single listing page in your Directorist business directory. Visitors instantly see what restaurants, cafes, hotels, and shops are near each listing — with star ratings, review counts, and photos — without leaving your site.

Built specifically for the Directorist business directory plugin. Works out of the box with any Directorist directory: classifieds, real-estate, hotel, restaurant, event, or general business listings.

Features

  • Real Yelp businesses on every Directorist single listing page
  • Modern React-based settings page (Directorist-style admin UX)
  • Grid view with photo, name, star rating, distance, and price
  • 6 Yelp categories (Restaurants, Food, Cafes, Bars, Shopping, Hotels)
  • Per-listing category and radius override — admin meta box AND frontend submission form
  • Sidebar widget for any Directorist sidebar
  • Auto placement — sidebar when active, below content otherwise
  • Themable templates (drop overrides into your theme’s listing-reviews-for-directorist-with-yelp/ folder)

Why Directorist users love it

If you’ve built a Directorist business directory, you know visitors often want context — “what’s around this place?” Without leaving your directory, they see real-time data on nearby restaurants, hotels, shops, and more. It’s the kind of feature that turns a directory listing into a destination.

External services

This plugin connects to the Yelp Fusion API to fetch nearby business data (name, address, photo, rating, review count, distance, price tier, category) for display on Directorist listing pages.

  • When data is sent: each time a Directorist single listing page is rendered (front-end view), the plugin sends a request to the Yelp Fusion API with the listing’s latitude / longitude, the configured search radius, and the configured category filter. No personally identifiable information about the site visitor is sent.
  • What is sent: the listing’s geographic coordinates, the radius (meters), the Yelp category slug, the result limit, and your Yelp API key in the Authorization header.
  • Where: https://api.yelp.com/v3/businesses/search
  • The plugin will only call this service after the site administrator has entered a Yelp Fusion API key in the plugin settings.

Yelp is a third-party service operated by Yelp Inc. By using this plugin, the site operator agrees to the Yelp API Terms of Use and Yelp’s Privacy Policy:

  • Yelp Fusion API Terms of Use: https://terms.yelp.com/developers/api_terms
  • Yelp Privacy Policy: https://terms.yelp.com/privacy/en_us/

“Yelp” is a trademark of Yelp Inc. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Yelp Inc.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Directorist plugin.
  2. Install Listing Reviews for Directorist with Yelp from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  4. Get a free Yelp Fusion API key at https://www.yelp.com/developers
  5. Go to Listings → Listing Reviews and paste your key.
sections.faq:
Does this work without Directorist?

No. This plugin requires Directorist.

Do I need a Yelp API key?

Yes. Yelp Fusion API keys are free for developers — sign up at https://www.yelp.com/developers. The plugin will not make any API calls until a key is configured.

Does the plugin send any visitor data to Yelp?

No. Only the listing’s coordinates, radius, category, and your API key are sent — no visitor IP, cookies, or personal data.
